title: Normalized tensor comparison for the explicit adic section equivalence
statement: For each prime ℓ and scheme X, the explicitly constructed comparisonModuleFunctor carries native balanced tensor to the sectionwise sheaf tensor, naturally in both variables and with the canonical pure-tensor section formula.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 03EO; balanced tensor comparison through sectionwise sheafification.

proof.text: For the sectionwise sheaf tensor, lift a restriction-compatible family of section-ring bilinear maps using TensorProduct.lift and the module-sheafification adjunction. Its unit gives the pure-tensor formula, and injectivity of the adjunction bijection plus tensor extensionality gives uniqueness. Naturality of the same unit computes tensor maps on pure tensors.

A lax braided functor carries the two internal bilinearity diagrams to the corresponding presheaf diagrams, by associativity and tensorator naturality. For the sheaf-to-presheaf functor the converse follows by detecting morphisms on threefold pure tensors: sheafification inverts its tensorator and its tensor with any presheaf. Thus native pure tensors are bilinear over the section rings. Conversely restrict a section-ring bilinear pairing along constant coefficients, extend it through vector-space sheafification, reflect the bilinearity diagrams, and apply the existing native balanced-coequalizer map Mod.tensorDesc. Mod.tensorLeft_obj_hom_ext and Sheaf.tensor_hom_ext prove uniqueness.

Use the explicit section-module equivalence and its counit to regard the sectionwise tensor pairing as a pairing into a native module; native descent gives the forward comparison. The sectionwise tensor universal property applied to the native pure-tensor pairing gives its inverse. The two pure-tensor formulas and the two extensionality principles prove both inverse identities. Compute the native tensor maps using Mod.tensorπ_map and Mod.tensorπ_tensorLeftMap, then prove naturality in both variables by native pure-tensor extensionality. Package the objectwise isomorphisms with NatIso.ofComponents and retain the exact normalized section formula.
